title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يحاضر في تركيا عن " ضوابط اعتبار البرلمان مرجعا تشريعيا اجتهاديا "
title_en: The Sheikh Lectures in Turkey on 'What Governs Treating Parliament as a Legislative Authority Exercising Independent Legal Reasoning'
body_ar: وصل فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي العاصمة التركية استنطبول و ذلك للمشاركة في مؤتمر: "الدولة و المجتمع .. نظرة مقاصدية " الذي تبدأ أعماله اليوم الاحد 06 إبريل 2014 الموافق 06 جمادى الثاني 1435هـ و المنظم من طرف جامعة السلطان محمد الفاتح الوقفية في استنطبول ـ تركيا بالتعاون مع المؤسسة الوطنية للدراسات و البحوث (نصر) ومؤسسة الفرقان للتراث الإسلامي و المنتدى السوري للإعلام؛ ويستمر المؤتمر لثلاثة أيام هي الاحد و الاثنين و الثلاثاء يناقش فيها المؤتمرون مختلف القضايا التي تهم الدولة و المجتمع؛ و تتمثل مشاركة فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في محاضرة افتتاحية بعنوان : " ضوابط اعتبار البرلمان مرجعا تشريعيا اجتهاديا" و يشارك في المؤتمر بالإضافة إلى الشيخ مجموعة من العلماء و المفكرين و الدكاترة المختصين .
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew al-Shinqiti has arrived in the Turkish capital, Istanbul, to take part in the conference 'The State and Society: A View from the Higher Objectives', whose proceedings begin today, Sunday 06 April 2014, corresponding to 06 Jumada al-Thani 1435 AH. It is organised by Fatih Sultan Mehmet Waqf University in Istanbul, Turkey, in cooperation with the National Foundation for Studies and Research (NASR), the Furqan Foundation for Islamic Heritage and the Syrian Media Forum.

The conference runs for three days — Sunday, Monday and Tuesday — during which those attending discuss the various questions that bear on the state and society.

The contribution of His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew is an opening lecture entitled 'What Governs Treating Parliament as a Legislative Authority Exercising Independent Legal Reasoning'. Taking part in the conference, besides the Sheikh, is a group of scholars, thinkers and specialist academics.

options: note that Ankara, not Istanbul, is the capital of Turkey
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11): the record calls Istanbul the Turkish capital. Translated as the source has it and flagged rather than silently corrected. The spelling استنطبول is also non-standard for إسطنبول.

flags.context: the title of the Sheikh's lecture
options: What Governs Treating Parliament as a Legislative Authority Exercising Independent Legal Reasoning
The Conditions for Regarding Parliament as a Source of Legislation by Ijtihād
The Limits within which Parliament May Be Taken as a Body of Legislative Ijtihād
flags.note: CRITICAL. The title is the whole substance of this record and its wording carries a position: that a parliament may be treated as a body exercising collective ijtihād, subject to conditions. The English must preserve both halves — the ضوابط (governing conditions) and the اجتهادي character — because dropping either turns it into a claim the Sheikh has not made here. The record contains only the title, not the lecture; nothing of his argument or of the conditions themselves has been supplied.

translator_notes: A conference announcement, not a text by the Sheikh. Only the title of his lecture is given; it is not summarised or reported.
جامعة السلطان محمد الفاتح الوقفية is the university's own name, Fatih Sultan Mehmet Vakıf Üniversitesi; the English uses the institution's usual English form rather than translating الوقفية.
